name: game-modding-toolkit
description: Build application MCP integrations and package tools, server connections and reusable skills as Codex plugins.

interface.longDescription: Inspect application capabilities with REA, Ghidra and ILSpy; expose supported operations through scoped MCP adapters; package the tools and skills for Codex. Existing asset pipelines remain available separately.
defaultPrompt: Map this application's supported capabilities and design a scoped MCP integration.
Package this MCP server and its reusable workflows as a Codex plugin.
Validate the application integration with an isolated reproducible fixture.
